description:
Start paid LightX recamera on an owned source video.

First call estimate_lightx_recamera with the same source video and camera settings. max_cost_rub is
required and must cover the maximum hold. Original source audio is preserved. Returns a job ID; read get_video.
Even a completed job/webhook may have is_hold=true: poll get_video until is_hold=false for final cost.

max_cost_rub.description: Maximum hold confirmed from the LightX recamera estimate; never exceeded.
max_cost_rub.title: Max Cost Rub

target_pose.description: Required when camera='target'; 5-element target pose [theta, phi, radius, x, y].
target_pose.title: Target Pose

trajectory.description: Required when camera='traj'; theta, phi, and radius arrays.

video_url.description: Source video from your own uploads or results; at least 49/24 seconds and at most 15 seconds.
video_url.title: Video Url

name: create_lightx_recamera
